question: On Oct. 22, 1974, the Flyers beat the Kings 4-2 in L.A. How many straight games did Philadelphia then go without losing to Los Angeles?
question_short: Oct. 22, 1974: Flyers beat the Kings. How many straight games until L.A. beat Philly again?
answer_detail: Philadelphia's unbeaten run against Los Angeles lasted more than eight years. It finally ended on Feb. 13, 1983, when the Kings won 5-4 in Philadelphia.
answer_short: Philly went 32 straight without a loss to L.A., until February 1983.
